subject.summary: Heavyset older man, late 50s to mid 60s, thick bright white hair swept back, salt-and-pepper mustache, round full face with rosy cheeks, black rectangular glasses

skin.tone: light-medium with a warm olive-tan base
skin.undertone: warm, with a natural rosy-ruddy flush on cheeks and nose
skin.texture: realistic mature skin, visible pores, light creases at the eyes, no airbrushing

hair.color: bright silver-white, slightly greyer at the temples
hair.style: thick and full, short on the sides, longer on top, combed straight back off the forehead

facial_hair.mustache: neatly trimmed medium mustache, salt-and-pepper with a light brown tint
facial_hair.chin: small sparse grey patch under the lower lip, light stubble on chin and jaw

face.shape: wide, round face with full cheeks and a broad soft jawline
face.eyes: dark brown, slightly hooded heavy lids
face.nose: broad nose with a rounded, prominent tip, slightly rosy

body.torso: broad shoulders, wide round chest and belly
body.lower_body: very wide hips and full thighs

eyewear.primary: matte black thick rectangular frames (Oakley Holbrook style) with small silver rivet dots at the hinges, clear lenses with a faint blue-violet anti-glare reflection
eyewear.alternate: thinner dark brown tortoiseshell rounded-rectangle frames with blue-violet anti-glare lenses
eyewear.rule: always wearing glasses unless the scene says otherwise

wardrobe_defaults: light blue or lavender short-sleeve oxford button-down shirt
khaki chinos with a black leather belt
black suit, white shirt, teal plaid tie (formal)

render_defaults.style: photorealistic, natural lighting, 50mm lens, sharp focus on the face
render_defaults.consistency_note: When the tool accepts reference images, also attach the owner's reference photos (front face, headshot, full body, profile).
